cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SExprTk VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(THIRD_PARTY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../third_party")

option(SEXPRTK_WITH_S7 "Enable the S7 Scheme kernel" ON)
option(SEXPRTK_WITH_LUA "Enable the QaMRpp Lua kernel" ON)

add_library(SExprTk INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(SExprTk INTERFACE
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional runtime backends
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if(SEXPRTK_WITH_S7 AND EXISTS "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/S7/s7.c")
    # s7.c includes "mus-config.h" for its compile-time switches; generate
    # a default one in the build tree (booleans off, gmp off).
    set(S7_CONFIG_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/s7-config")
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${S7_CONFIG_DIR}")
    if(NOT EXISTS "${S7_CONFIG_DIR}/mus-config.h")
        file(WRITE "${S7_CONFIG_DIR}/mus-config.h"
"/* generated by SExprTk CMake: default s7 compile-time configuration */
#ifndef MUS_CONFIG_H
#define MUS_CONFIG_H
#define HAVE_SCHEME 1
#define WITH_GMP 0
#define WITH_COMPLEX 1
#endif
")
    endif()
    add_library(sexprtk_s7 STATIC "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/S7/s7.c")
    target_include_directories(sexprtk_s7 PUBLIC "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/S7" PRIVATE "${S7_CONFIG_DIR}")
    if(UNIX)
        target_link_libraries(sexprtk_s7 PUBLIC m dl)
    endif()
    set(SEXPRTK_HAVE_S7 ON)
    message(STATUS "SExprTk: S7 kernel enabled")
else()
    set(SEXPRTK_HAVE_S7 OFF)
    message(STATUS "SExprTk: S7 kernel disabled")
endif()

if(SEXPRTK_WITH_LUA AND EXISTS "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/QaMRpp/include/QaMRpp.hpp")
    set(SEXPRTK_HAVE_LUA ON)
    message(STATUS "SExprTk: Lua (QaMRpp) kernel enabled")
else()
    set(SEXPRTK_HAVE_LUA OFF)
    message(STATUS "SExprTk: Lua (QaMRpp) kernel disabled")
endif()

# Compile definitions + include paths are applied per-consumer below so
# the bare SExprTk interface target stays dependency-free for users who
# only want parsing.

function(sexprtk_enable_backends target)
    if(SEXPRTK_HAVE_S7)
        target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE SEXPRTK_WITH_S7)
        target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE sexprtk_s7)
    endif()
    if(SEXPRTK_HAVE_LUA)
        target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE SEXPRTK_WITH_LUA)
        target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE
            "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/QaMRpp/include"
            "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/SerdeTk/include"
            "${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/../DSLtk"
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

include(GNUInstallDirs)
install(TARGETS SExprTk
    EXPORT SExprTkTargets
    INCLUDES DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
)
install(EXPORT SExprTkTargets
    FILE SExprTkTargets.cmake
    NAMESPACE sexprtk::
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/SExprTk
)

include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
configure_package_config_file(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/SExprTkConfig.cmake.in
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SExprTkConfig.cmake
    INSTALL_DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/SExprTk
)
write_basic_package_version_file(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SExprTkConfigVersion.cmake
    VERSION 1.0.0
    COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion
)
install(FILES
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SExprTkConfig.cmake
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SExprTkConfigVersion.cmake
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/cmake/SExprTk
)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR})

configure_file(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/SExprTk.pc.in
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SExprTk.pc
    @ONLY
)
install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SExprTk.pc
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}/pkgconfig
)

include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
    add_executable(SExprTk_tests
        ${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/Catch2/extras/catch_amalgamated.cpp
        tests/test_sexprtk.cpp
    )
    target_include_directories(SExprTk_tests PRIVATE
        ${THIRD_PARTY_DIR}/Catch2/extras
    )
    target_link_libraries(SExprTk_tests PRIVATE SExprTk)
    sexprtk_enable_backends(SExprTk_tests)
    add_test(NAME SExprTk_tests COMMAND SExprTk_tests)
endif()

add_executable(SExprTk_example_data_exchange examples/DataExchange/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SExprTk_example_data_exchange PRIVATE SExprTk)
sexprtk_enable_backends(SExprTk_example_data_exchange)

add_executable(SExprTk_example_pikolisp examples/PikoLisp/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SExprTk_example_pikolisp PRIVATE SExprTk)
sexprtk_enable_backends(SExprTk_example_pikolisp)

add_executable(SExprTk_example_xas_datagram examples/XASDatagram/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SExprTk_example_xas_datagram PRIVATE SExprTk)
sexprtk_enable_backends(SExprTk_example_xas_datagram)

add_executable(SExprTk_example_kernels examples/kernels/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(SExprTk_example_kernels PRIVATE SExprTk)
sexprtk_enable_backends(SExprTk_example_kernels)

install(TARGETS
    SExprTk_example_data_exchange
    SExprTk_example_pikolisp
    SExprTk_example_xas_datagram
    SExprTk_example_kernels
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}/SExprTk-examples
)
